newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina raises wheat crop estimate to 15.2 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Argentina raises wheat crop estimate to 15.2 mln T.

text.p: Argentina Thursday raised its 1996/97 wheat harvest forecast to 15.2 million tonnes from 14.9 million tonnes, Agriculture Secretary Felipe Sola said.
Sola told reporters that approximately one million tonnes of the crop was affected by quality problems and will probably be sold as forage grain.
He said Argentina was creating three new marketing categories of forage wheat, allowed to include up to a maximum 10 percent, 30 percent or 50 percent of sprouted grain.
The highest quality forage grain is already being sold in Argentine markets at a price comparable to maize, he added.
"Argentina has a slight quality problem, which doesn't affect more than a million tonnes," Sol said.
Wheat crop in the southern heart of Argentina's wheat belt was lashed by torrential rains and high winds last week, causing Argentine prices to jump and ruffling grain markets around the world.
